recipe_type.description: Type of the recipe. E.g. dessert, main course, breakfast.

function.name: poker_probability_full_house
function.description: Calculate the probability of getting a full house in a poker game. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

deck_size.description: The size of the deck. Default is 52.

hand_size.description: The size of the hand. Default is 5.

function.name: hospital_locate
function.description: Locate nearby hospitals based on location and radius. Options to include specific departments are available. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city and state, e.g. Denver, CO

radius.description: The radius within which you want to find the hospital in kms.

department.description: Specific department within the hospital. Default to none if not provided.
